title: Validate network join secret before rotation
summary: Prevalidate the exact coordinator secret-transfer blob before rotating any config, app-state, or running-runtime token authority.
reason: Remediate CSW-2026-07-09-NETWORK-001. Join-blob preflight used a shorter placeholder token, then committed rotation before final exact-token encoding could fail.
behavior_before: A near-limit payload could pass placeholder preflight, rotate config/app-state/runtime credentials, then fail final encoding and return no replacement join blob.
behavior_after: The exact candidate token and complete join blob are validated once before mutation; persistence failure leaves the running token unchanged, and commit failures retain compensating rollback evidence without exposing secrets.
tests_added: Near-limit exact-token encoding failure leaves config, app-state, and running-runtime authorities unchanged.
Exact join-blob encoding occurs once before rotation commit, and one token reaches config, app-state, runtime, and the returned blob.
Injected running-coordinator persistence failure rolls config back and keeps the old live token without secret disclosure.
A rotated token persisted by one spawned process is reloaded by a distinct spawned process from the same app-state file.
manual_validation: Focused network join/security/lifecycle/done-release suites passed: 103 tests and 16 subtests; touched Python Ruff and compileall checks passed.
Local API and WebView network boundary suites passed: 75 tests and 777 subtests; the real-browser network smoke passed against disposable state without executing confirmed lifecycle commands.
The broader network suite passed 475 tests and 167 subtests; its sole failure was the pre-existing unrelated pending-publish rerun-claim KeyError for pending_publish_payload_path.
The active reliability wrapper passed architecture, native process cleanup, runtime-state hygiene, and sidecar safety before stopping at the established unrelated WebView static-asset assertion.

A full Windows release build with -Zip -Verify -IncludeTests ran for 897 seconds. Tool integration and end-to-end smoke passed; aggregate verification exited 1 only on established WebView static-asset, dependency-cycle, generated/status-doc, tracked-document, and unrelated Ruff baselines.

All five finding-specific implementation/test/document files matched the preserved package by SHA-256. Inside that exact package, 103 network tests plus 16 subtests, 75 Local API/boundary tests plus 777 subtests, and the real-browser network smoke passed using bundled runtimes.
rollback_plan: Revert the exact-token join preparation, transactional coordinator-token persistence, focused network/Local API/restart tests, documentation, generated artifacts, and packet metadata together. Do not restore placeholder preflight or post-mutation encoding.
notes:
High-risk network secret transaction boundary. No source/scratch/output media, queue, publish, rename, or lifecycle start/stop was performed. Validation used disposable config/app-state and loopback or in-memory coordinator instances; representative real-media validation was not required. Python impact: coordinator join orchestration and runtime token persistence semantics with focused secret redaction, transaction, two-process recovery, and Local API coverage. Immutable audit evidence remained read-only.
Bound exact join-blob validation ahead of token authority mutation and made running-token persistence fail closed. Existing overlapping changes in facade.py, both network test modules, and the Local API matrix were preserved; coordinator_auth.py was clean before this batch. Known unrelated worktree baselines remain outside this packet: three stale summaries, DOC005 at the active audit BASELINE reference, the mediapipeline.core.processes to mediapipeline.core.queue dependency cycle, two rename-test Ruff B023 findings, the WebView static-asset reliability assertion, and package/generated-document drift.
